whiff_rate.description: Whiffs per swing -- outcome-only, no tracking required.

called_strike_rate.description: Called strikes per taken pitch -- outcome-only.

in_play_rate.description: Balls in play per pitch thrown -- outcome-only.

avg_spin_rate.description: Mean spin rate -- requires tracking; noted in Phase 1A as less reliable than velocity even at tracked venues.

zone_rate.description: Share of pitches located in the strike zone -- a location/command proxy; requires tracking (zone is a Trackman-derived field).

chase_rate.description: Swings on pitches outside the zone -- requires tracking to know zone.
